sources.title: Apply for our award-winning current account | Starling
Apply for our award-winning current account | Starling

brands.evidence: Monzo is the alternative I'd consider if customer service matters more to you than overseas cash withdrawals.
I'd choose Starling if you want one app-based UK current account for your salary, bills and everyday spending.

client_claims.text: In the August 2026 Great Britain survey, 79% of Monzo customers said they'd recommend it, versus 76% for Starling.
client_claims.note: Survey figure of 79% is not covered by the facts; F4 gives an NPS of 76, a different metric, so this is not directly comparable.
Facts mention a free plan but do not state the account has no monthly fee explicitly.
No fact covers cash deposit fees.

client_claims.text: Outside the European Economic Area, Monzo charges 3% on cash withdrawals above £200 in a rolling 30-day period.
client_claims.note: Matches the £200 per 30 days allowance outside the EEA and 3% fee after it.
